Quick technical clarifications re: RTO/RPO and Dedicated vs Hosted:
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): backups are nightly plus continuous replica of KV cache; RTO for customer-owned VPC depends on their network provisioning but typical time-to-serve is under 1 hour once we spin up dedicated nodes in the target region.
- Hosted: our multi-az architecture enables the 2 hour RTO for region-level failover. For customers with stricter RTO/RPO we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Private + quantized model artifacts stored in your object storage for faster restore.
